abstract_state.context: Complete resolver inputs: source and origins, successful and negative lookups, import/export visibility, module roster, dependency graph, options/builtins, plugin and rewriter identities/configuration/order/state, and relevant cancellation/completion state.
abstract_state.cache: Mathematical map from exact structural semantic key to immutable semantic observation or restricted value summary.
abstract_state.observation: Diagnostics including source origin, resolved bindings/signatures/member relationships, verifier inputs/outcomes where claimed, and current owner/declaration identity.
abstract_state.resolver_assumption: Fresh resolution is deterministic over the complete context. Determinism is a premise requiring independent implementation evidence, not derived for Dafny C#.

implementation_state.payload: ModuleResolutionResult contains ResolvedDeclaration, ErrorReporter, Signatures, and nested ClassMembers dictionaries; these are reference-bearing C# objects.
implementation_state.current_path: Patches 0004-0006 keep ordinary-module safe revalidation fresh. Patch 0005 permits only a value-only empty export summary, rebuilding a result wrapper/reporter/dictionaries for the current declaration. Patch 0006 adds an immutable string-name audit that never authorizes reuse.

candidate_simulation_relation.relation: For each current compilation context c, returned C# result r simulates abstract Resolve(c) iff r is observationally equivalent across required diagnostics and origins, bindings/signatures/members, verifier inputs/outcomes, and owner/declaration identity; every reattached mutable reference must be current-owner safe or proven immutable and detached.
candidate_simulation_relation.required_determinism: Equal complete contexts imply equivalent fresh-resolution observations, including diagnostic ordering/provenance where externally observable.
candidate_simulation_relation.required_key: Key equality must imply equality of the complete semantic context. Include successful and failed lookups, scope/visibility and import/export views, module additions/removals/renames and dependency identities, options/builtins, plugins/rewriters and their order/state, source origin and clone/synthetic identity as needed.
candidate_simulation_relation.collision: A digest collision must not be treated as semantic equality unless the implementation confirms full structural context equality; otherwise compare a complete witness or fail closed to fresh resolution. SHA-256 collision behavior is not modeled by the structural Dafny proofs.
candidate_simulation_relation.owner_safe_reconstruction: Never return a prior ModuleResolutionResult graph across compilations unless a verified reconstruction rebases every declaration, token/origin, signature key, member key, scope, and reporter reference. A value-only immutable summary may be reused only when its branch contract is proved and the current graph-owned wrapper and all mutable containers are rebuilt.
